subject.title: fix: prevent session-changed errors after reset

question: Should OpenClaw adopt lifecycleRevision as a shared agent-harness reset and plugin session-end contract for plugin-owned retained-session generation fencing?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive cross-plugin lifecycle API decision; automated review can confirm the narrow shape but cannot choose the permanent ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve the narrow shared contract
options.body: Accept the two optional lifecycleRevision fields after exact-head behavior proof confirms that they solve retained-session cleanup without changing unrelated lifecycle consumers.

options.title: Keep the fence Codex-local
options.body: Ask for a redesign that avoids extending generic lifecycle contracts if maintainers do not want this ownership fact exposed to all harnesses and session-end hooks.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow shared contract
recommendation.body: Accept the two optional lifecycleRevision fields after exact-head behavior proof confirms that they solve retained-session cleanup without changing unrelated lifecycle consumers.
